title: Frequently Asked Questions
description: From setup to support, here are the answers you need to launch faster with confidence.

items.question: Do you build the backend API or database?
items.answer: Not your backend logic. Your engineers still own the API routes, auth, and business logic. What Tulip does keep in sync is the design layer: design tokens stay 1:1 across your Master Figma files, your Drizzle/Supabase database schema, and your Next.js repositories. That strict boundary is how we move so fast.

items.question: Can I customize everything in the template?
items.answer: Yes, all components, layout blocks, typography tokens, and colors are built with 100% standard Tailwind CSS and Figma variables so you can effortlessly adapt them to your brand.

items.question: Is this template only for SaaS founders?
items.answer: While designed primarily for SaaS founders and digital product builders, agencies, solo hackers, and studios can use Tulip to ship high-converting pages in record time.

items.question: How fast can I get my site live?
items.answer: With our synchronized Figma design system and ready-to-deploy Next.js repository, you can launch a production-ready website in as little as 48 hours.

items.question: Can I use this for client projects?
items.answer: Yes! Once you acquire the system, you have full ownership of the code and design files to use for both personal and commercial client projects with zero lock-in.

items.question: Is Framer free to use with this template?
items.answer: The Next.js repository is completely self-contained and free of any subscription dependencies. You can host it on Vercel, Netlify, or AWS with zero ongoing licensing fees.

items.question: How does Tulip integrate with my AI coding assistant or Cursor IDE?
items.answer: Tulip operates via the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Once an operator approves a component or token in our Operator Taste Dashboard, your AI development environment instantly reads those governed blocks, ensuring AI builds your application with exact brand components and zero hallucinated styling.
